name: conversation-namer-codex
description: Automatically name new Codex conversations and safely batch-normalize titles in the current project.

interface.shortDescription: Give Codex conversations consistent, date-prefixed titles.
interface.longDescription: Uses the first request to name a new conversation as MMDD｜TYPE｜Topic, and provides a confirmation-gated skill for batch-normalizing conversation titles in the current Codex project. It changes titles only and never changes project names or conversation organization.
